blocks.text: ‘MANILA, Philippines — The Chinese embassy in Manila has once again responded to statements by members of the House of Representatives, criticizing not only lawmakers who have called out Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan but also those who have questioned other Chinese diplomats. In a series of social media posts on Wednesday, the embassy responded to remarks by Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon and Las Piñas Rep. Mark Anthony Santos. On Wednesday morning, the embassy responded to Ridon’s call to expel diplomatic officers, “particularly those operating the Chinese embassy’s Facebook account,” amid their continued online criticism of Philippine government officials. “Why […]...
